concept.title: Read the caller-visible contract
paragraphs: Start with the receiver, input types, return type, and accessibility. A return type promises what a successful caller receives; it does not hide failure meaning.
Use IntelliSense one parameter or member at a time rather than memorizing a dense signature.

lab.title: VS Code Fluency: Navigate, Manipulate, Run, and Recover
lab.objective: Practice VS Code navigation, refactoring, formatting, IntelliSense, terminal, and diagnostic workflows without touching TimeClock.
lab.task: A disposable product-price calculator with intentionally awkward names and one compiler error.
lab.startingCondition: Prerequisites: the .NET SDK, VS Code or another C# editor, and basic ability to run dotnet commands. No numbered session or optional module is required. Create exercises/optional/vscode-fluency from scratch.

steps.text: Step 1/12: Create an isolated console project with dotnet new console -o exercises/optional/vscode-fluency. Do not add it to PinkMachine19.TimeClock.sln and do not edit TimeClock production code.
Step 2/12: Open exercises/optional/vscode-fluency/Program.cs and remove only the template Hello World statement.
Step 3/12: At the top of Program.cs, add a comment naming the scenario: A disposable product-price calculator with intentionally awkward names and one compiler error.
Step 4/12: Use Quick Open to open Program.cs without clicking through folders.
Step 5/12: Use Go to Definition on CalculateOrderTotal, then Go Back to return to its call.
Step 6/12: Use Find References on itemCount and inspect every result.
Step 7/12: Rename Symbol from itemCount to quantity without using text replacement.
Step 8/12: Deliberately misspell Console.WriteLine, build, open the compiler diagnostic, and navigate to the error.
Step 9/12: Restore Console.WriteLine, request IntelliSense for the method call, and run Format Document.
Step 10/12: Toggle the integrated terminal, run the project, and verify the order total.
Step 11/12: Build with dotnet build exercises/optional/vscode-fluency --configuration Release. Read any diagnostic before changing code.
Step 12/12: Run with dotnet run --project exercises/optional/vscode-fluency --configuration Release, then open Solution Reveal and compare every line.

reveals.title: Solution
reveals.text: Complete isolated solution. Keep it in this module folder only.
